tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and default tile ground.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating light-gray tiles, footer band, grouped sections.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Store-style cards and menus that sit above surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-alt and surface-elevated (15:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Subheads, meta text and nav submenu labels on surface and surface-alt (4.5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholder only. Fails 4.5:1 on surface (3.6:1 light), so never use it for body copy; 24px+ or decorative marks only.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline text links and the secondary (outline) button text and border on surface and surface-alt (5.6:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary pill button fill. The single brand hue; use it for actions, never for decoration.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (4.6:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, input borders and footer rules.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element (3:1+ on every surface).

tokens.name: nav-bg
tokens.usage: Translucent global nav bar; pair with backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(20px).

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: Global nav links on nav-bg.

tokens.name: tile-dark-bg
tokens.usage: Always-dark product tile, in both themes.

tokens.name: tile-dark-ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and subheads on tile-dark-bg (19:1).

tokens.name: tile-dark-link
tokens.usage: Links and outline buttons on tile-dark-bg (7:1).

tokens.name: footer-ink
tokens.usage: Footer and legal text on surface-alt (4.7:1 light).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive messages, always with an error sentence, never color alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Availability and confirmation text (In stock, Delivered), always with a word.

families.display: "SF Pro Display", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.text: "SF Pro Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: hero-headline
styles.usage: One per page: the top hero product line.

styles.name: section-headline
styles.usage: Headline that opens a full-width section.

styles.name: tile-headline
styles.usage: Product name on a promo tile at desktop width.

styles.name: intro
styles.usage: Large menu links and section intros.

styles.name: tile-subhead
styles.sample: Find their perfect match this season.
styles.usage: One-line tagline under a tile headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Free delivery and returns on every order.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Pill buttons on tiles. Use 17px for a standalone large button.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Footer, legal and footnotes, in footer-ink.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside a pill button.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked promo tiles and between tile columns.

tokens.name: space-btn-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside a pill button (exact, not a grid step).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between two buttons in a CTA row; footer top padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Side gutter of the page container.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tile top padding above the headline.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Global nav bar height (48px below 834px).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of nav and footer content.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed promo tiles on the home grid.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text fields and search inputs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Store cards and inset media.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button: always a full pill.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Store cards on surface-alt; resting state.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Store card on hover, with a 1.01 scale.
